people.name: Belshazzar
people.line: The last Emperor of Babylon, son of Nabonidus.

translations.web: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords, and drank wine before the thousand.
translations.bsb: Later, King Belshazzar held a great feast for a thousand of his nobles, and he drank wine with them.
